name: OC Session Guard
description: Session bloat, idle admission guard & tool result hygiene — strips bloat fields, purges stale subagents, blocks idle model calls, truncates oversized tool outputs, and collapses poll loops. Squashes large intermediate discovery/inspection tool-result bursts into atomic summaries at turn end (T-583).

suppressIdleHeartbeats.description: Block automated heartbeat turns when no actionable tasks are due to prevent idle model calls

headChars.description: Number of characters to preserve from the head of tool outputs

tailChars.description: Number of characters to preserve from the tail of tool outputs

maxToolResultChars.description: Max threshold before truncating tool outputs

enablePollDeduplication.description: Enable collapse and suppression of zero-delta poll frames

rollupTransientSteps.description: Squash large intermediate discovery/inspection tool-result bursts into one atomic summary at turn end (agent_end), without interrupting reasoning mid-turn

rollupMinBurstSize.description: Minimum consecutive transient tool results before a burst is squashed

rollupTransientTools.description: Tool names treated as transient discovery/inspection steps

rollupTailChars.description: Tail characters preserved from the final result of a squashed burst
